Reading pages as text

An agent reads a page as text far more often than it looks at it. This paragraph is long enough for the extractor to judge the article element as the main content of the page, which is what the test below relies on, so it goes on for a few more words than a fixture usually would and then a few more after that.

What is kept

Markdown keeps links, emphasis and lists, and the second paragraph gives the article enough text to outweigh the navigation and the footer by a wide margin, whatever the scoring thresholds are tuned to in the future.
